description: This script is a Perl source file for creating firmware images for Broadcom-based devices, specifically replacing the brcmImagebuilder. It handles reading image files, padding, and constructing firmware headers and images.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates padding length needed to align size to a block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to a specified block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs a firmware image with headers and writes it to output file.
